title.text: What if every man had the same girlfriend?

messages.label: MESSAGES TO HER
messages.sub: ONE TEXT PER MAN PER DAY

lines.l02: Every man alive is suddenly her boyfriend.
lines.l03: Same girlfriend, in every time zone.
lines.l04: Every table is booked for her.
lines.l07: Phone networks were never built for this.
lines.l08: Her street becomes a waiting room.
lines.l09: She never said yes to any of them.
lines.l12: Nobody knows whose turn it is.
lines.l13: Everyone has plans for her life.
lines.l15: Then Nora makes her own choice.
lines.l16: If nobody chose it, is it still love?
lines.l18: WOULD YOU ACCEPT THIS WORLD — OR WALK AWAY?
